title: Aaron Rodgers says 2026 will be his final NFL season: ‘This is it’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Rodgers says 2026 will be his final NFL season: ‘This is it’
sources.description: Aaron Rodgers has said that the 2026 season will be the final one of his NFL career. The four-time MVP agreed last weekend to return to the Steelers on a one-year deal reportedly worth up to $25m. The 42-year-old, who is entering his 22nd NFL season, led the Steelers to the AFC North division title last season.
